records.rationale: The diff shows Admin::EmbeddingController#update just calls render_serialized on @embedding fetched by fetch_embedding, never applying any params, and the client's saveChanges calls this.get('embedding').update({}) with an empty payload. So the PUT endpoint is verifiably a no-op returning current state, making the frontend save action silently do nothing.

records.issue_text: Migration db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:24 interpolates raw site-setting host value into INSERT SQL; a host with a quote breaks the migration and is an injection vector; should use quote/parameterization
records.rationale: The migration line `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, ...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)"` directly interpolates the migrated site-setting value `h` into raw SQL without quoting or parameterization. A host value containing a quote would break the migration and allow SQL injection into the INSERT. Verified directly in the diff.
